title: Midnight
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, frozen small town at night in winter, stopped clocks and faded New Year's Eve decorations, icy blue and tarnished gold tones, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Final part. Midnight finally came to Merrow Falls. Nothing happened. 🎆

Original fiction. New series tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Theo's watch ticked toward midnight, and every stopped clock in Merrow Falls ticked at once.
scenes.image: a clock tower over a snowy town at night, a crowd frozen below it

scenes.narration: Midnight. The clock tower struck. Twelve slow bells rolled across the snow.
scenes.image: a great bronze bell swinging in a frosted clock tower at night

scenes.narration: Theo braced for it. The pressure. The leaning sky. The thing they'd held off for twenty-seven years.
scenes.image: a man in a grey coat in an alley, bracing against a wall, eyes squeezed shut

scenes.narration: Nothing happened. Not a sound. Not a shadow.
scenes.image: a quiet snowy street at night, completely still, string lights glowing

scenes.narration: The crowd cheered. Champagne popped. Confetti fell. The band played the old song about old friends.
scenes.image: confetti falling over a cheering crowd in a snowy square under string lights

scenes.narration: Theo laughed until he cried. Twenty-seven years. For nothing.
scenes.image: a man laughing with tears on his face, confetti in his hair, crowd blurred behind

scenes.narration: Then Delia found him. She wasn't celebrating. She said: oh, Theo. We were never keeping something out. We were hiding. From the year 2000. From everything after.
scenes.image: the old clockmaker standing in the falling confetti, looking at him with pity

scenes.narration: Merrow Falls didn't stop the clocks to keep something out. It stopped them so the future would never find it.
scenes.image: a small snowy town seen from far above at night, a tiny island of light in total darkness

scenes.narration: Theo ran to his car. His watch read 11:59. December thirty-first, 1999. And the road out of town led straight back into Main Street, where they were hanging the streamers up again.
scenes.image: car headlights on a snowy road leading straight back into a lit town square with streamers

scenes.narration: Some things never freeze, no matter how cold it gets. Tomorrow: a lake with one round patch of water that never freezes.
scenes.image: a frozen lake at night with one perfectly round patch of dark open water, mist rising
